Nicaragua is well suited to an itinerary where volcanoes, lakes, colonial cities and two coastlines follow one another without long, monotonous stretches. From Granada, it is easy to add Mombacho Volcano, while León can be combined with volcanic and nature routes in the country's northwest.

Ometepe Island in Lake Nicaragua was formed by two volcanoes, Concepción and Maderas. Allow several days here for hiking, cycling and nature observation. Matagalpa and Estelí add rural areas, coffee plantations and local production to the journey.

The Pacific coast around San Juan del Sur is ideal for surfing and beach holidays. The source itinerary also highlights Remanso, Maderas, Las Peñitas and Colorado beaches. In the Caribbean, the Corn Islands offer a different experience: beaches, snorkeling and diving.

Ada Tours can arrange a dedicated journey through Nicaragua or include the country in a combined Central American itinerary. Cities, volcanoes, lakes and several days by the sea can all form part of one trip.

Panama is ideal for a journey that combines a major modern city with tropical nature and islands. Spend time exploring Panama City's neighborhoods and the Panama Canal, then continue towards the Caribbean, the Pacific or the mountains.

Boquete and the Panamanian Highlands offer a quieter, nature-focused part of the trip. Add trekking, birdwatching and outings to Baru Volcano. The original material also highlights Pipeline Road near Panama City as a place for watching birds.

For the marine portion, consider Bocas del Toro, San Blas, the Pearl Islands, Isla Grande and Coiba. The itinerary can include beach relaxation, snorkeling, diving, surfing or boat excursions.

Ada Tours can arrange a standalone journey through Panama or include the country in a combined Central American itinerary. Panama City, nature areas and several days on islands can all fit into one trip.

Paraguay is a good destination for combining urban history, natural areas and major rivers in a single trip. Allow time in Asunción for architecture, museums, the botanical garden and local cuisine, then continue east or south.

Encarnación and the Trinidad area offer a cultural stage in southern Paraguay. The Jesuit missions of Trinidad de Paraná and Jesús de Tavarangue, highlighted in the original material as major historical attractions, are located here.

In the east, the itinerary can continue through Ciudad del Este to Itaipu Dam and the Paraná River. For nature experiences, consider the Gran Chaco, Lake Ypacaraí, Ybycuí National Park and other areas where bird and wildlife watching can be included.

Ada Tours can arrange a dedicated journey through Paraguay or combine the country with Brazil and Argentina. Food-focused stops and fishing on the Paraná River can also be part of the program.

  - eyebrow: Capital and culture
    title: Paramaribo
    text: Paramaribo's historic center combines Dutch colonial architecture, religious buildings belonging to different communities and the country's multiethnic culture. The capital makes a convenient starting point for journeys into the interior.
    image: /media/countries/suriname/block-085-generated-20261011-dedup-v1.webp

    title: Brownsberg and Brokopondo
    text: From Paramaribo, the itinerary can continue to the Blommestein Reservoir, Brokopondo Dam and Brownsberg National Park, with boat trips, hiking trails, waterfalls and nature watching.
    image: /media/countries/suriname/featureBands-2-enhanced-20261002.webp
  - eyebrow: Atlantic coast
    title: Galibi and sea turtles
    text: On the coast around Galibi, a nature excursion can include sea turtle watching. Suriname's beaches are generally better suited to an exploratory journey than to a standalone resort holiday.
    image: /media/countries/suriname/featureBands-3-enhanced-20261002.webp
sourceUrl: https://brasiltours.ru/surinam-ru
sourceSnapshot: page_texts_original/surinam-ru__9168c20b.md

Suriname is particularly well suited to experienced travelers interested in nature, rivers and remote regions. Tropical rainforest covers a large part of the country, and waterways often form the backbone of a journey. Allow extra time and do not expect conventional resort infrastructure far from the capital.

Paramaribo offers a cultural contrast to the nature-focused part of the trip. In its historic center, Dutch colonial buildings stand near mosques, synagogues and places of worship belonging to different communities. From here, travelers can continue up the Suriname River towards Brokopondo and Brownsberg National Park.

For more active days, consider hiking trails, waterfalls, river journeys and fishing. The original material also highlights Kasikasima Mountain, Marie Blanche Falls and the coastal Galibi area, where sea turtles may be observed.

Ada Tours can arrange a standalone journey through Suriname or combine it with Guyana, French Guiana and Brazil. This lets travelers experience Paramaribo, tropical forests, rivers and the coast on one trip.
